locations: 19 sovereign G20 countries listed in config/study.json
draw_count: all available posterior draws; do not assume 1000
mandatory_provider_metadata: published final release and model version, not intermediate sequela draws
meaning of draw identifiers and confirmation of joint alignment across countries, ages, years and infertility types
whether numerator, subtype and any uncertain population draws are coherently aligned
whether primary plus secondary equals total within each draw after final reconciliation
licensing, permitted derived-result publication and redistribution conditions
acceptance_checks: complete dimensional coverage, unique cell/draw keys, finite nonnegative values
draw identity and alignment verified from provider metadata, not inferred from column names
reproduce supplied marginal summaries within provider-specified numerical tolerance
subtype additivity and annual denominator consistency
compute contrasts and decompositions separately for each accepted draw, then summarize quantiles
fallback: If no confirmed aligned draws, do not create GBD intervals from marginal limits, independent simulations or country bootstrap.
